summary: This note describes Ap Lo Chun, a small island in the New Territories of Hong Kong. It sits in Ap Chau Bay between Ap Chau to the east and Sai Ap Chau to the west, with the islet of Ap Tan Pai nearby to the northeast. The island is administered by North District.
one_line: Ap Lo Chun is a small island in Hong Kong's New Territories, located in Ap Chau Bay and administered by North District.
key_facts: Ap Lo Chun is a small island in the New Territories of Hong Kong.
Ap Lo Chun is located in Ap Chau Bay.
Ap Lo Chun lies between Ap Chau in the east and Sai Ap Chau in the west.
The islet of Ap Tan Pai is nearby to the northeast of Ap Lo Chun.
Ap Lo Chun is under the administration of North District.
